volunteerMapping.rule: The app uses fixed animal-zone volunteer credentials. Real volunteer names/photos may be assigned operationally later; they are not required for meme references or deployment.

memeReferences: Participants must understand the pose within about 5 seconds.
No small text or captions are required for the joke to work.
No dangerous contact, lifting, jumping, lying on the floor, or intimate poses.
Volunteer faces must remain clearly recognisable.
Reference image is shown on participant phones only, never on projector.
mysterySources: One clear absurd action per image.
Square-ish source composition, with key subjects centred enough to survive 7x4 portrait-phone cropping.
No tiny critical text, watermarks, logos, or positional clues.
Use strong silhouettes, gestures and connected visual elements across the frame so partial phone tiles remain interpretable.
Funny and surreal, but not visually chaotic or impossible to describe in one sentence.

mysteries.title: Dinosaur Event Escape
mysteries.action: A senior rides away on a dinosaur while three juniors chase behind waving event registration forms.
mysteries.composition: Dinosaur and senior centre-left, chasing juniors crossing the frame from right, papers visibly flying.

mysteries.title: Attendance Register Chase
mysteries.action: A professor chases a student who is sprinting away clutching the attendance register like stolen treasure.
mysteries.composition: Student runs diagonally across foreground, professor behind, giant recognisable register in student's arms.

mysteries.title: Cat Viva
mysteries.action: A very serious cat conducts an engineering viva while nervous students sit in front of it with notebooks.
mysteries.composition: Cat behind desk near centre, students facing it, one student visibly panicking.

mysteries.title: Printer Duel
mysteries.action: A student has a dramatic sword-fight-style duel with a college printer that refuses to print a lab record.
mysteries.composition: Printer and student on opposite sides, long sheet of paper connecting the action across the centre.

mysteries.title: Penguin Seminar
mysteries.action: A penguin confidently presents an engineering seminar while students in the audience take notes as if everything is normal.
mysteries.composition: Penguin at presentation board, audience spread across lower half, pointer gesture obvious.

mysteries.title: WhatsApp Group Fisher
mysteries.action: A senior literally fishes first-years out of a giant pile of floating WhatsApp group icons using a fishing rod.
mysteries.composition: Senior on one side with rod, students tangled in oversized green chat-bubble shapes across the frame; no readable app text required.

mysteries.title: Assignment Time Machine
mysteries.action: A student desperately tries to enter a homemade time machine while another student points at an assignment deadline clock.
mysteries.composition: Time machine on left, deadline clock and pointing student on right, strong directional action between them.

mysteries.title: Lab Record Sacred Procession
mysteries.action: Students carry one lab record through campus like a sacred treasure while a faculty member runs after the procession.
mysteries.composition: Record held overhead in centre, students around it, faculty chasing from rear.

mysteries.title: Canteen Reach Problem
mysteries.action: A giraffe reaches through a canteen window and steals the final plate of biriyani while students react in horror.
mysteries.composition: Long giraffe neck crosses several tile regions, plate central, students on both sides reacting.

mysteries.title: One Working Socket
mysteries.action: A group of engineering students worships the only working power socket while a koala calmly charges a laptop from it.
mysteries.composition: Socket and koala/laptop central, students kneeling or celebrating around it.

mysteries.title: Canteen Chef Bear
mysteries.action: A bear wearing a chef apron serves one tiny plate of food to a huge queue of extremely hungry students.
mysteries.composition: Bear behind counter, tiny plate held up, student queue extending across frame.

mysteries.title: Hall Ticket Surfing
mysteries.action: A student surfs through campus on an enormous hall ticket while friends run behind trying to catch them.
mysteries.composition: Oversized paper acts like surfboard across centre, student standing on it, runners trailing.

mysteries.title: Deadline Sprint
mysteries.action: A rabbit in a tiny backpack races a student toward a giant glowing assignment deadline button.
mysteries.composition: Rabbit and student sprint side-by-side, destination object on opposite side of frame.

mysteries.title: Midnight Assignment Professor
mysteries.action: An owl wearing spectacles lectures exhausted students at midnight while a wall clock dramatically shows a very late hour.
mysteries.composition: Owl near board, moon/window and large clock visible, sleepy students across foreground.

mysteries.title: Final Porotta Guardian
mysteries.action: A crocodile guards the final porotta in the canteen while students attempt an overdramatic rescue mission.
mysteries.composition: Porotta plate central, crocodile guarding it, students approaching from multiple directions.

mysteries.title: Underwater Placement Interview
mysteries.action: A shark conducts a formal placement interview underwater while a student in formal clothes tries to answer seriously.
mysteries.composition: Shark and student across a desk, bubbles and fish establish underwater setting, clear interview posture.

mysteries.title: Dolphin Project Demo
mysteries.action: A dolphin demonstrates a laptop project to a panel while students proudly stand beside it.
mysteries.composition: Dolphin pointing toward laptop/project, panel opposite, students flanking.

mysteries.title: Timetable Leak
mysteries.action: A parrot flies through a college corridor dropping exam timetable papers while students chase below trying to catch them.
mysteries.composition: Parrot high centre, papers falling across frame, students moving underneath.

mysteries.title: Broken Lab PC Rescue
mysteries.action: A gorilla carries a broken desktop computer toward technical support while relieved students follow behind.
mysteries.composition: Gorilla and computer central, loose cables visible, students following and pointing toward destination.

mysteries.title: Assignment Smuggler
mysteries.action: A kangaroo secretly stuffs stacks of assignments into its pouch while a suspicious faculty member approaches.
mysteries.composition: Kangaroo centre with obvious papers in pouch, faculty entering from side, students trying to signal warning.
